Subject: Novasys onboarding MAP & cutover cadence

Hi Elena / Ricardo —

Thanks again for a good conversation yesterday. Attaching a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short cutover cadence that reflects the timeline we discussed. High-level asks:

- Please confirm the owner listed for each milestone and any internal approvals that will be required (security, legal, procurement).
- Let us know if the pilot window needs to shift (we proposed 2028-08-01 to 2028-08-15).
- If procurement wants a separate SOW redline, please send the contact; I’ve cc’d Marissa from CS for onboarding logistics.

Summary of key milestones (from MAP_v1):
1) Pilot kickoff (technical onboarding) — target 2028-08-01 — Owner: Novasys (Ricardo) / Redwood CS (Marissa)
2) Pilot validation & quality review — target 2028-08-10 — Owner: Novasys Data Team (Elena)
3) Production cutover planning & SLA alignment — target 2028-08-20 — Owner: Novasys Ops / Redwood Sales (Ben)
4) Contract signature & provisioning complete — target 2028-07-28 (procurement)

I left the acceptance criteria as bullet points in the MAP — quick checklist items we can convert to JIRA tasks if you prefer.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), draft_SOW_for_procurement (we can update after your comments).

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff on Monday 2028-07-09 at 10:00 PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with the draft agenda.

Thanks —
Naomi

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A few notes after syncing with Ops and Procurement:

- Procurement will need a redlined SOW before they can calendar the 7/28 signature. I attached our initial comments to the draft SOW (SOW_comments.pdf).
- We need to move the pilot start from 2028-08-01 -> 2028-08-08. One of our data engineers is out the first week of August.
- Acceptance criteria look good overall; can you add a short item to the Pilot Validation row about latency SLA checks and token-cost reporting? That will be required for our architecture sign-off.

If you can push the pilot start to 8/08 and add latency/cost checks, we’ll be able to sign off faster. Procurement (copied) — can you confirm expected lead time for countersignature once SOW is final?

Best,

Thanks Elena —

I updated the MAP (internal copy) with the pilot move to 2028-08-08 and added two acceptance checks under Pilot Validation:
- Latency verification: synthetic traffic run with 95th percentile < 300ms for sample queries
- Cost reporting: sample token burn report and per-route cost estimate shared with Novasys engineering

I’ll own the onboarding tasks and will assign an Integration Engineer (name TBD) once we confirm the kickoff time. Proposed agenda for the 7/9 meeting remains useful but we should switch it to 7/11 or 7/12 to give Procurement time — Elena, which of those dates is better for you?

Also attaching a short checklist we use for customer previews (no sensitive data) to show what we’ll need from Novasys (API keys, sample transcripts, expected volume). Happy to move these into a shared Drive link once you approve.
